Package com.example.eventlottery.controller

Class EventController

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventlottery.controller.EventController
public class EventController extends Object
Controller for event browsing, filtering, and lottery criteria. Responsibilities: - Load all events from the repository - Filter events by category, location, availability, and capacity - Search events by keyword across name, description, and category - Generate lottery criteria text for a given event User stories supported: - US 01.01.03: See a list of events to join the waiting list for - US 01.01.04: Filter events based on interests and availability - US 01.01.05: Search for events by keyword - US 01.01.06: Use keyword search with filtering - US 01.05.05: Be informed about lottery selection criteria
Version:
1.2
Author:
Fawaz Mansoor

    • applyAllFilters

      public List<EventSummary> applyAllFilters(String keyword, String category, String location, boolean openOnly, int maxCapacity, long afterDateMs)
      Applies all filters and keyword search together.
      Parameters:
      keyword - search term (empty = no keyword filter)
      category - category filter ("All" = no filter)
      location - location filter (empty = no filter)
      openOnly - if true, only show events with open registration
      maxCapacity - max capacity filter (0 = no filter)
      afterDateMs - only show events after this date (0 = no filter)
      Returns:
      filtered and searched list of events
